# Zulivio

> Self-hosted sales CRM and workforce operations by NodeDR: leads, call logs, follow-ups, scoring, deals, employee records, attendance and task assignment. A scoped REST API (leads and calls), signed webhooks and an MCP server (per-employee keys) are available. Requires the business to run its own instance.
